settings.title: How B2B checkout works here
settings.body:
Retailers sign in with OTP, build a cart (MOQ enforced per variant), and place orders on credit or prepaid with payment proof.

Distributors confirm stock, move orders through processing, dispatch, and delivery — invoices align with your Nest invoice settings.
